newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank reverse repo drains 61 bln SKR.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank reverse repo drains 61 bln SKR.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday that it drained 61 billion crowns from the market in its morning reverse repurchase operation.
The reverse repo was set at a fixed 5.15 percent, a 10 basis point cut from last week's operation, and will run from September 11 to September 18.
It replaces an operation set at a fixed 5.25 percent that drained 64 billion crowns from the market.
The Riksbank said 14.58 percent of the bids for the new tender were allocated.
